[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Ekelarc Yong''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Ekelarc flew as [[Gray Three/Legends|Gray Three]] as a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] [[pilot]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (1 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVCEXBattleOverEndor1.asp}}</ref> with [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]]<ref name="CCGGSP" /> under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="rotj" />
[[File:Famous_Star_Destroyers_RotJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Ekelarc Yong crashes on the ''Chimaera'' during the Battle of Endor.]]

He held the rank of lieutenant at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the battle.<ref name="Hasbro" />

Following the destruction of a [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|wingless Mon Calamari star cruiser]] by the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]], Ekelarc joined the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and a squad of starfighters, including an X-wing flown by [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix]] and his Y-wing, against the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]].<ref name="rotj" />

During the attack on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], he was shot down by two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. Losing control and spinning wildly, he made one last cry, "I'm hit!," before crashing into the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="rotj" /> [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].<ref name="Insider105">{{InsiderCite|105|25 Years of Return of the Jedi!|25 Years of ''Return of the Jedi''!|reprint=1}}</ref>

His [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the battle was [[R5-P9]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ekelarc Yong first appears as an unidentified character in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. In the film, he was most likely portrayed by English actor [[Timothy Sinclair]], who was listed as a Y-Wing pilot on a Production Callsheet, along with [[Eiji Kusuhara]] and [[Errol Shaker]].<ref name="Diversity In Space>{{WebCite|url=https://www.npr.org/sections/codeswitch/2014/12/29/372670957/diversity-in-space-tracking-the-first-asian-pilot-in-the-star-wars-movies|text=Diversity In Space: Tracking The First Asian Pilot In The Star Wars Movies|author=Haruch, Steve|date=2014-12-14|work=[[Wikipedia:National Public Radio|National Public Radio]]|archivedate=20190518192028}}</ref> Ekelarc Yong had no known [[canon]] name for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], though he had been mistakenly referred to by the [[fanon]] name "J'ef Hsu." His name and call sign were finally revealed in an action figure set "Battle Over Endor," from Hasbro.<ref name="Hasbro" />
